dps_shared.translation: "And if I, being of a nature to get old, who is not exempt from old age, would see another old person and would become troubled, ashamed and disgusted, this would not be suitable for me".
dps_shared.example: ahañceva kho pana jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭīyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ na metaṃ assa patirūpan'ti.
